title: Savings account overview
content: A savings account is used to deposit money and maintain funds. Account-specific details require appropriate authentication.

title: Card security guidance
content: Never share your card PIN, CVV, password or one-time password with anyone. Contact the bank through its verified official channel if card details may be compromised.
keywords: card security PIN CVV password OTP

title: Transaction dispute guidance
content: If you notice a transaction you did not authorise, report it immediately through the bank's verified official channel. A human fraud specialist should review the case.

title: Loan information
content: Loan eligibility, interest rates and repayment terms depend on the applicable product and approved bank policy. Obtain current terms from an authorised bank representative.

title: Complaint handling
content: Customers may request a formal complaint review. The complaint should be recorded and routed to an authorised support team for follow-up.
